# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp BPF filter for the `fd_shredcap_tile` process. The [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_shredcap_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_shredcap_tile>) function fills a `sock_filter` array with rules that first verify the runtime architecture and then allow only `SYS_write` and `SYS_fsync` calls with specific file descriptors such as `shreds_fd`, `requests_fd`, `logfile_fd`, `fec_fd`, and `peers_fd`. Any syscall or argument combination that does not match these rules is set to `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`. The file also defines `sock_filter_policy_fd_shredcap_tile_instr_cnt` as the number of filter instructions and uses a compile-time architecture check to reject unsupported targets.
